name: UMANARAYANI AYURVEDIC HAIR OIL
subtitle: Traditional Herbal Care for Beautiful Hair
shortDescription: Discover the goodness of traditional Indian hair care with Umanarayani Ayurvedic Hair Oil. Inspired by time-honoured herbal ingredients, this hair oil is designed to nourish the scalp, condition the hair, and help maintain soft, smooth, and naturally shiny-looking hair.
description:
Discover the goodness of traditional Indian hair care with Umanarayani Ayurvedic Hair Oil. Inspired by time-honoured herbal ingredients, this hair oil is designed to nourish the scalp, condition the hair, and help maintain soft, smooth, and naturally shiny-looking hair.

Crafted according to classical Ayurvedic Kshirapak / herbal infusion principles, this oil deeply penetrates the scalp layers to deliver essential botanical nutrients right to the roots without heavy synthetic greasiness. It transforms dull, damaged, and brittle hair into strong, vibrant, and silky locks with consistent ritualistic care.
keyBenefits: Helps nourish and condition the scalp.
Helps improve hair softness and manageability.
Supports smooth, shiny-looking hair.
Helps reduce dryness-related hair breakage.
Makes scalp massage and regular hair care more enjoyable.

ingredientsDetails.name: Brahmi
ingredientsDetails.description: Cools the crown, reduces stress-induced shedding, and revitalizes follicles.

ingredientsDetails.name: Nagarmotha
ingredientsDetails.description: Deeply cleanses scalp microbiome and anchors hair shafts.

ingredientsDetails.name: Bhringraj
ingredientsDetails.description: Legendary Ayurvedic herb renowned for stimulating dormant hair follicles.

ingredientsDetails.name: Amla & Amarbel
ingredientsDetails.description: Rich in natural Vitamin C; supports length retention and deep natural pigmentation.

ingredientsDetails.name: Shikakai & Methi Dana
ingredientsDetails.description: Provides natural gloss, detangles knots, and replenishes hair keratin vitality.

howToUse: Apply a suitable amount to the scalp and hair. Massage gently with your fingertips. Leave on for 30–60 minutes, then wash thoroughly with shampoo.

usageSteps.title: Dispense
usageSteps.text: Take 5–10 ml of oil into palms or warm slightly for a relaxing champi.

usageSteps.title: Scalp Massage
usageSteps.text: Part hair into sections and massage gently into scalp using circular finger motions.

usageSteps.title: Nourish
usageSteps.text: Leave on for 30–60 minutes (or overnight for intense hydration).

usageSteps.title: Rinse Clean
usageSteps.text: Wash thoroughly with Umanarayani Herbal Shampoo for radiant results.

suitableFor: People looking to maintain nourished, soft, and manageable hair.

faqs.q: Can I leave this oil overnight?
faqs.a: Yes! While leaving it on for 30–60 minutes gives great results, leaving it overnight provides intense deep-conditioning for dry or stressed scalps.

faqs.q: Is this suitable for both men and women?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Umanarayani Ayurvedic Hair Oil is formulated for all genders and hair textures.

faqs.q: How often should I use it?
faqs.a: For best results, use 2 to 3 times a week followed by Umanarayani Herbal Shampoo.

name: UMANARAYANI NATURAL AYURVEDIC MEHNDI
subtitle: 100% Pure Rajasthani Henna Powder for Hair Care & Conditioning
shortDescription: Pure Rajasthani henna (mehndi) leaf powder for natural hair conditioning, root cooling, and vibrant rich copper-brown shine.
description: Umanarayani Natural Ayurvedic Mehndi is crafted from 100% pure, chemical-free henna leaves cultivated in the sun-drenched soils of Sojat, Rajasthan. Triple micro-filtered for silkiness, it coats the hair cuticle with intense plant nutrients, relieves scalp heat, controls dandruff, and imparts a deep, healthy botanical shine.
keyBenefits: 100% Pure Rajasthani Henna leaf powder
Deep botanical conditioning & scalp cooling champi
Imparts rich, natural copper-brown botanical shine
Helps control dandruff and soothes scalp itchiness
Zero ammonia, zero PPD, and zero synthetic additives

ingredientsDetails.name: Pure Mehndi (Lawsonia Inermis)
ingredientsDetails.description: Triple-sifted pure henna leaves that bond with keratin to strengthen hair shafts.

ingredientsDetails.name: Amla & Brahmi
ingredientsDetails.description: Enhances pigment retention and deeply nourishes scalp roots.

howToUse: Soak required powder in lukewarm water or black tea decoction for 2–3 hours. Apply evenly to parted hair from roots to tips. Leave on for 1–2 hours, then rinse thoroughly with plain water.

usageSteps.title: Mix Paste
usageSteps.text: Mix 50–100g of Mehndi powder with lukewarm water or herbal tea into a smooth, yogurt-like paste.

usageSteps.title: Rest
usageSteps.text: Let the mixture sit in an iron or glass bowl for 2–3 hours for optimal herbal release.

usageSteps.title: Apply Evenly
usageSteps.text: Section your hair and apply the paste generously from roots to ends wearing gloves.

usageSteps.title: Rinse Clean
usageSteps.text: Leave on for 60–120 minutes. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water without shampoo.

suitableFor: All hair types seeking 100% pure, chemical-free conditioning and natural color.

faqs.q: Does this mehndi contain any chemicals or synthetic dye?
faqs.a: No, it is 100% pure, unadulterated Rajasthani henna leaves with zero artificial color, PPD, or preservatives.

faqs.q: How often can I apply this?
faqs.a: For deep conditioning and vibrant color, apply once every 2 to 4 weeks.

name: UMANARAYANI AYURVEDIC HERBAL UBTAN
